source: Tamaoka, Makioka, Sanders & Verdonschot (2017), www.kanjidatabase.com: A new interactive online database for psychological and linguistic research on Japanese kanji and their compound words. Psychological Research 81, 696–708.
corpus: Mainichi newspaper 2000–2010; individual reading fields cover two-kanji compounds, excluding proper nouns
acquisition: Public lookup form, then server-generated CSV export request. Exact response bytes retained. No source values repaired or normalized. Jukugo export supplies independent word-frequency totals for 理.
